nav.label: Sections
nav.drawerNote: Playing, joining servers and installing bundles stay in JKNet on your PC.

signin.title: Sign in to JKNet
signin.intro: Chat with your friends from your phone or your browser.
signin.waiting: Finish signing in on the page that opened.
signin.expired: The sign-in took too long. Try again.
signin.installFirst: On iPhone, add JKNet to the Home Screen first and sign in there: the installed app keeps its own sign-in.
signin.doneElsewhere: This browser has no sign-in to finish. If you signed in from the installed JKNet app or another browser, go back there: you are signed in there.

install.title: Install the app
install.body: Installed, JKNet opens from the home screen and can show notifications.
install.iosSteps: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
install.installed: JKNet is installed on this device.
install.homeScreen: Add JKNet to your Home Screen
install.iosPush: On iPhone and iPad, notifications reach only JKNet opened from the Home Screen, on iOS 16.4 or later.
install.iosStep1: Tap Share in the browser's toolbar.
install.iosStep3: Open JKNet from the Home Screen and sign in there.
install.manual: Your browser installs JKNet from its menu: look for Install app or Add to Home screen.
install.banner: Install JKNet: it opens from your home screen and shows notifications.
install.bannerIos: Add JKNet to your Home Screen to get notifications on this device.

tabs.title: JKNet is open in another tab
tabs.body: Only one tab stays connected at a time.

offline.banner: No connection. Messages wait and go out once you are back online.

update.available: A new version of JKNet is ready.
update.required: This version of JKNet is too old. Update to carry on.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.soundText: Plays whenever JKNet is open in this browser, even in a background tab. This choice stays on this device.
notifications.unavailable: Notifications are not available right now.
notifications.blocked: Notifications are blocked in the settings of the browser.

preview.full: Name and start of the message

notifications.pushText: Notifications reach this device while JKNet is closed. The settings below apply to this device only: the launcher and your other devices keep their own.
notifications.enableText: Your browser asks once whether JKNet may show notifications.
notifications.unsupported: This browser cannot receive notifications from JKNet.
notifications.blockedHint: Allow notifications for this site in the site settings of the browser, then come back here.
notifications.notAllowed: The browser did not allow notifications. Try again and choose Allow.
notifications.loading: Loading the settings of this device…
notifications.masterHint: Off: this device stays quiet and keeps its settings.
notifications.pauseHint: No notifications on this device for a while.
notifications.atPcHint: You are at your PC while JKNet on your PC is online or in a game, or while JKNet is open on another device.
notifications.quietHint: Every day, this device gets no notifications in these hours. Time zone: {{zone}}.
notifications.mentionsBreakHint: An @mention of you still notifies in quiet hours.
notifications.silentHint: Notifications arrive quietly. While JKNet is open they are always quiet: the app plays its own sound.
notifications.perChat: A chat's own level (all messages, only mentions, or muted) is set in the chat's menu and applies on every device.
notifications.testSent: Sent. The notification arrives in a few seconds.
notifications.noDelivery: No notification has reached this device yet.
notifications.otherDevicesText: Other devices of your account that get notifications.
notifications.pushTextNew: Notifications reach this device while JKNet is closed.

push.test: Notifications from JKNet work on this device.

serverChats.title: Friends’ servers
serverChats.guestNote: You're a guest on this server. Chat from here, join the game from JKNet on your PC.
serverChats.gone: This chat is no longer available

serverList.title: Server list
serverList.lead: Servers the master servers list, checked by JKNet Online. Join them from JKNet on your PC.
serverList.unavailable: The server list is not available right now
serverList.unavailableText: JKNet Online is not collecting the server list yet. Try again later.
serverList.errorTitle: The server list did not load
serverList.emptyText: JKNet Online is asking the master servers. The list fills in within a minute.
serverList.notListedTitle: This server is not in the list right now
serverList.notListedText: It did not answer the last checks, or the master servers no longer name it.

jkhub.title: JKHub mods
jkhub.lead: Maps, skins, sabers and more from JKHub. Install them from JKNet on your PC.
jkhub.unavailableTitle: The JKHub catalog is not available yet
jkhub.unavailableText: JKNet Online has not built its copy of the JKHub catalog yet. Try again later.
jkhub.emptyText: Nothing in the catalog matches this search. Try fewer words, or another category.
jkhub.notFoundTitle: This file is not in the catalog
jkhub.notFoundText: JKHub may have removed it, or the catalog of JKNet Online does not know it yet.

friendsScreen.inviteNote: Join the game from JKNet on your PC.
friendsScreen.none: No friend requests or server invites right now.
friendsScreen.gone: This player is not on your friends list.

account.signOutText: Signs this browser out. Your account and your friends stay.
account.deleteText: Removes the account, your friends, your invites and your chats from the service.
account.deleteBody: Your account, your friends list, your invites and your chats are removed from the service. This cannot be undone.

catalog.playNote: To play here, open JKNet on your PC.
catalog.installNote: Install from JKNet on your PC.
catalog.communityLead: Open a server to read its page or share it in a chat. Join from JKNet on your PC.
catalog.bundlesLead: Ready-made client sets from JKNet Online. Install them in JKNet on your PC.
catalog.bundlesEmpty: A bundle is a set of clients another player put together: engines, files and settings. Players publish them from JKNet on their PC.
